title: Sort signups by country
prompt: Return first_name, country and signup_date for every customer. Sort by country from A to Z. Inside each country, put the newest signup first.
hints: There are two sort keys. Which one comes first?
Each key can have its own direction.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Reverses the country order as well.
Sorts by date alone and ignores the country.

feedback: Read your result from the top. Countries should run A to Z, and inside one country the dates should run from newest to oldest.
